as_of.description: NAV cutoff date. Defaults to today in Asia/Kolkata; separate from investor position date and actual NAV date.

date.description: Actual NAV observation date, on or before as_of; never relabelled as the requested cutoff.

time_zone.description: Financial-date timezone used for the default cutoff.

freshness.description: Age is measured against the requested NAV cutoff, not the position date. recent means age_days <= 3; stale means greater than 3.

position_date.description: Supplied investor-position observation date, or null when omitted. It does not establish current ownership and must not exceed as_of.

ownership_status.description: Supplied quantities and dates are not independent verification of current ownership.

valuation_basis.description: Exact decimal units multiplied by latest positive INR NAV on or before as_of.
